name: quoxmind-complete
tagline: Self-improving intelligence that compounds over time.
description: Unlocks the full QuoxMind Cognitive Implant Suite including the reflective tier: QuoxReflect (self-evaluation), QuoxDream (knowledge consolidation), and QuoxLearn (behavioural adaptation). Includes everything in QuoxMind Pro.
shortDescription: Full cognitive implant suite with self-improvement
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: QuoxReflect: Post-action evaluation and quality feedback
QuoxDream: Memory consolidation and contradiction resolution
QuoxLearn: Behavioural adaptation that improves over time
The system gets measurably smarter with every operation

reflect.name: QuoxReflect Implant
reflect.description: Evaluates past actions — what worked, what failed, what to change. Inspired by the default mode network.

dream.name: QuoxDream Implant
dream.description: Consolidates memory — merges duplicates, resolves contradictions, elevates patterns into institutional knowledge. Inspired by sleep consolidation.

learn.name: QuoxLearn Implant
learn.description: Adapts behaviour based on accumulated experience. Changes decomposition, delegation, and communication over time. Inspired by synaptic plasticity.
